evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it with the alias “20th Research Institute of China Electronic Technology Group Corp (CETC)”. CETC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists.
It belongs to CETC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.
